title: Premeditatio malorum
idea: Rehearse what could go wrong before it does. When you have already faced the setback in your mind, it loses its power to shock you.
apply: Before a big event, list three ways it could fail and decide your response to each.
remind: Rehearse the setback. Then it cannot surprise you.
who: Priya, preparing a live demo for her company's board.

items.x: Live demo of the new dashboard

scenes.nar: Priya will demo a new dashboard live to the board on Tuesday. On paper, the plan looks perfect.

items.x: The live data will not load

scenes.nar: Most people stop there. If the Wi-Fi drops or the data fails, they freeze, and a long silence fills the room.
So Priya does what Seneca advised. She imagines it going wrong ahead of time, and prepares an answer to each failure.
At minute six, the Wi-Fi drops. She calmly plays the recording, and the board never notices. The failure had already happened in her mind.
